_doc: Warden's Orientation (R5 O1). steps[i] = {id,title,text,reason,target{kind,id},done{signal,...},nudge_ticks}. done.signal picks the evaluator in sim/tutorial/tutorial_system.gd; count/min_cells/where/or/latch are its parameters. Step ids audit/release are looked up by id.

steps.title: Form 1: Intake
steps.text: Select an inmate by tapping their portrait.
steps.reason: Inmate #1 will do your work. Paperwork says so.

steps.title: Form 7: Dig
steps.text: Open Orders, pick Mine and mark 3 rock cells.
steps.reason: Ore is the only currency the Warden respects.

steps.title: Form 8: Storage
steps.text: Open Zones and paint a stockpile of at least 4 cells.
steps.reason: Unstored ore is theft, or litter. Either is a violation.

steps.title: Form 9: Proof of Haul
steps.text: Wait until 10 ore lies in storage.
steps.reason: Refining needs stock. The Warden counts it twice.

steps.title: Form 11: Tools
steps.text: Build a workbench or a refinery from the Build menu.
steps.reason: Bare hands do not refine. Regulations are clear.

steps.title: Form 12: Dirty Hands
steps.text: Refine one batch. Watch the contamination bar rise.
steps.reason: Refining pays, and the planet remembers. That is the dilemma.

steps.title: Form 14: Research
steps.text: Open the research bench and finish your first tech.
steps.reason: Better tools lower the bill. Slightly.

steps.title: Form 15: Conveyance
steps.text: Lay 3 or more belt cells from a miner to a storage-in port.
steps.reason: Inmates tire. Belts do not file complaints.

steps.title: Form 16: The Forecast
steps.reason: Waves follow waste. Read the numbers before they read you.

steps.title: Form 17: Warden's Audit
steps.text: Creatures are coming. Raise the alarm or build a turret, then hold.
steps.reason: An audit is scheduled. This one is gentle and cannot take the pod.

steps.title: Form 18: Decoy
steps.text: Place a cheap decoy such as an Ash Beacon before the next wave.
steps.reason: Creatures chase the loudest target. Make it a cheap one.

steps.title: Form 99: Release
steps.text: Orientation complete. Tap to join the general population.
steps.reason: From here on, hints appear only when something goes wrong.
